$comment: Renamed `plugin-spec` → `specboard` (CEO, on the pivot). The old name read as 'a specification for
plugins', which this is not. The GitHub repo is still claude-plugin-spec — a plugin rename does not
rename the repo, so `/plugin marketplace add chinglaishu/claude-plugin-spec` is unchanged; only the
marketplace and plugin names became `specboard`, so installs are `specboard@specboard`.
The `hooks` key is gone because v1's briefing hook was deleted in the pivot to the board. `skills`
is loaded by CONVENTION from skills/ — do not list it here. Naming it registers it a second time and
Claude Code rejects the duplicate ('Duplicate hooks file detected'), failing the whole load. Verify
with `claude --plugin-dir . plugin list` — the only thing that reads this file; nothing in the
repo's own tests can catch a mistake here.
name: specboard
description: A visualised spec-driven development board: every screen as its requirements and the tests that prove them against the real app — drift derived rather than tracked, coverage tagged at assertion granularity, and one human gate: are these the requirements I meant.
